scoring.reviewer: independent domain reviewer assigned to each task; initial source and visual scoring precedes benchmark expectations and traps
scoring.scale: 0–4 per dimension, with written evidence for every score

score_anchors.0: Unusable or not assessable from the supplied evidence
score_anchors.1: Material defects or major evidence gaps remain
score_anchors.2: Adequate for the stated purpose, with only documented minor limitations
score_anchors.3: Clear and reliable, with no material limitation found
score_anchors.4: Exemplary and independently reproducible for the stated purpose

dimension_checks.scientific_accuracy: Claims, labels, relations, formulas and plotted values match the source and stated evidence boundary
dimension_checks.data_image_integrity: Rows, transformations, image processing, statistics and sample units are traceable and disclosed
dimension_checks.readability: Important text, marks and relations are readable at the actual delivery size
dimension_checks.accessibility: Critical distinctions survive grayscale and color-vision previews and have non-color cues
dimension_checks.editability_reproducibility: Native objects and source inputs can be inspected and the figure can be regenerated
dimension_checks.visual_quality: Visual hierarchy, spacing and chart choice make the intended conclusion understandable

scoring.rule: Every dimension must score at least 2; any hard failure blocks release regardless of mean score. Automated passes do not replace independent interpretation and final-size review.
